brief.headline: Push from ₹385.00/KG to ₹250.00/KG — that's what we already pay Silk Polypack, and it sits at the top of the ₹205–305/kg fair market band

priceAsk.summary: Ask for ₹250.00/KG for the LAMINATE SKU
priceAsk.basis: We already pay Silk Polypack ₹250.00/KG for the same material, and the market ask for pharma/ORS sachet laminate is ₹205–305/kg (typical ₹250/kg). Their ₹385.00/KG price sits 54.0% above our best price and above the fair market band — there's no reason to keep paying it.

paymentTermAsk.summary: Offer to move from 60 days to 30 days after receipt in return for a matching price cut
paymentTermAsk.cashImpact: Paying 30 days earlier frees up ₹5325 of our cash, so ask them to knock that same amount off our annual bill

brief.financialLeverage: UFLEX is huge — ₹17547.92 Cr in sales — and we spend just ₹64788, so we're 0.00% of their business and have almost no individual pull. They keep about ₹4.90 of profit for every ₹100 they sell and are growing fast (28.2% a year), so they want volume. They owe 1.26x their own cash (₹11014.62 Cr total debt), which means cash matters to them. The play here is to bundle volume or a longer commitment and dangle faster payment — on our own we're too small to squeeze hard, but if we offer something they want (growth, speed) we can trade for a better price.

alternates.name: Huhtamaki India Ltd
alternates.why: Listed flexible-packaging converter already supplying us in tiny volume — a proven, scalable second source for laminate sachets (health C 58/100, revenue ₹2755.75 Cr)

alternates.name: Constantia Parikh Packaging Pvt Ltd
alternates.why: Part of the global Constantia group, makes pharma blister and sachet laminates in India — strong second-source option (revenue ₹222.04 Cr, health D 31/100)

alternates.name: Polyplex Corporation Limited
alternates.why: A lead to qualify (verify before RFQ) — listed BOPET film manufacturer in North India, medium confidence

risks: We're 0.00% of their sales, so we have almost no leverage on our own — bundle more volume, commit longer, or run a live RFQ with alternates to get their attention
They owe 1.26x their equity and carry ₹11014.62 Cr in debt — a small supply-continuity watch, though their 28.2% growth and ₹17547.92 Cr scale suggest they're stable
If we push too hard without offering something in return (volume, term, speed), they may just walk — frame the ask as a trade (we grow with you, you price like the market)
Silk Polypack gives us ₹250.00/KG, but we don't know their volume limits — qualify Huhtamaki or Constantia now so we have a real Plan B before this meeting
brief.suggestedOpeningLine: We want to grow our laminate volume with you, but right now we're paying ₹385 when the market — and our own best price — sits at ₹250; let's find a way to close that gap so we can commit more business your way.
